source.title: Age-related declines in visuospatial working memory correlate with deficits in explicit motor sequence learning

confidence_rationale: Supplies the missing MECHANISM behind the 2-5 range while undercutting its status as a constant. Chunk length correlates with visuospatial working-memory capacity within both young and older adults, and older adults show a joint reduction in BOTH capacity and chunk length. So the small-integer chunk size is downstream of a capacity bottleneck rather than being a primitive of the chunking system -- which is a satisfying explanation for why the number lands near the classic short-term capacity range, and simultaneously a warning that it is agent-specific and can shift. Source quality 0.72 (J Neurophysiol, correlational, moderate n); mapping fidelity 0.60; transfer risk 0.42.
failure_signatures: Chunk length tracks working-memory capacity across individuals and declines with age alongside it. A chunk-size budget hard-coded at 2-5 for every REE agent asserts a uniformity the human data specifically contradicts -- the budget should be derived from whatever plays the capacity role in REE, not set by fiat.

The correlation between capacity and LEARNING RATE held in young adults but NOT in older adults, while the capacity-to-chunk-length correlation held in both. Chunk size and formation rate are therefore dissociable, so MECH-323's R_min (repetition count) and its size budget should not be calibrated as if they were governed by one underlying quantity.

This is explicit sequence learning with a declarative component. If REE's accumulator is meant to be the DLS-analog procedural path (Graybiel repetition-and-consistency, value-flat), a capacity-derived size bound imported from an explicit task may be importing the wrong system's constraint.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Visuospatial working-memory capacity predicts the rate of motor sequence learning and the length of motor chunks formed during explicit sequence learning in young adults. Older adults exhibited a correlation between visuospatial working-memory capacity and motor sequence chunk length, as observed previously in young adults, and showed an overall reduction in both working-memory capacity and motor chunk length relative to young adults. Individual variations in capacity did not correlate with learning rate in older adults.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the best available answer to why the empirical chunk-size range sits at 2-5 rather than anywhere else: it is a working-memory capacity limit expressing itself in the motor domain. For MECH-323 that converts the budget from an arbitrary constant into a derived one. If REE has an analog of visuospatial working-memory capacity -- the number of policy primitives the agent can hold jointly while evaluating a candidate sub-sequence -- then the chunk-size budget should be READ OFF that quantity rather than configured independently, and it should move when that quantity moves (development, load, degradation). The age effect additionally predicts a testable REE signature: degrade the working-memory analog and chunk length should shorten while the chunking machinery stays otherwise intact.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Correlational, not causal -- capacity and chunk length covary but the paper cannot show that capacity SETS chunk length, and a third factor (general processing speed, which also declines with age) is not excluded. The task is EXPLICIT motor sequence learning, which recruits declarative and working-memory resources that MECH-323's DLS-analog procedural accumulator is specifically not supposed to depend on; the capacity constraint may therefore belong to a different system than the one REE is modelling here. Finally, 'chunk length' is again finger-press grain, so the transfer to policy primitives inherits the whole ARC-071 grain caveat. Treated as an explanation of the range's ORIGIN, not as an independent confirmation of the numbers 2 and 5.
mapping.source_context: Young and older healthy adults; explicit visuomotor sequence learning with chunk length derived from response-time structure; visuospatial working-memory capacity measured separately.

confidence_components.notes: Direction 'mixed': supports the magnitude of the 2-5 range by explaining its origin, weakens its status as a fixed architectural constant. Transfer risk elevated by the explicit-learning / procedural-system mismatch.
